name: File Upload Options
description: Per-field control over what happens when an uploaded file has the same name as an existing one: rename the new file, replace the existing file, or reject the upload. Applies to file/image widgets, code-defined fields, and REST file uploads.
project_description:
File Upload Options lets you specify, per file or image field, what should happen when an uploaded file has the same name as a file that already exists. The four choices map to core's file-exists constants: leave core's current behaviour, rename the new file (EXISTS_RENAME, core default), replace/overwrite the existing file (EXISTS_REPLACE), or prevent the upload with an error (EXISTS_ERROR). Fields are discovered automatically from every file/image field on the site and grouped by entity type on one settings form at Admin -> Config -> Media -> File Upload Options.

It works without replacing any widget or field type. Instead it overrides the managed_file element's #value_callback so uploads are routed through the module's own save routine, which reads the configured option for that field and passes it to core's file-save pipeline. File and image fields, inline entity forms, and fields defined in code (registered under "Custom fields" by machine name) are all supported. REST file uploads are supported too: the module swaps core's file:upload REST resource for its own subclass that honours the same option and, on Replace, re-uses the existing file entity with the matching URI instead of creating a new one. An optional integration with filefield_paths sets the same replace behaviour for path-processed files. The module installs at weight -10 so it runs before other file-handling modules.
